Class ResourcePlanetSectionBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.resource.ResourcePlanetSectionBuilder
public class ResourcePlanetSectionBuilder extends Object

Resource Planet Section Builder

Modular UI builder and coordinator for the inherited planetary preset section in ResourceDistributionPanel. Handles thermodynamic synthesis deduction, slider adaptation, and automatic cartographic raster coupling.

Version:
1.0.0
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
